SEC-001Implemented

Local human authentication and secure password hashing

Core · Security & IAM · Owner: Information Security

Acceptance boundary

Local human authentication and secure password hashing is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Executable first-party controls and automated evidence exist for SEC-001; production operation still depends on institution configuration and monitored deployment.

SEC-002Partial

Enterprise OIDC/SAML federation, certified provider policy, code/PKCE/JWKS validation, MFA/device assurance and session binding

Core · Security & IAM · Owner: Information Security

Acceptance boundary

A tenant can independently certify exact issuer/audience/metadata, MFA, login/logout and group mappings for a supported enterprise IdP without letting the IdP bypass canonical authorization.

Current maturity and gap

The protocol runtime, governed metadata/key rotation, exact-byte cryptographic logout verification and persistent exhaustive simulator campaigns are executable. Remaining gap: no commercial IdP/MDM/SAML-gateway tenant, provider-native fixture certification or witnessed provider conformance is live.

    Cryptographic OIDC verification plus fail-closed SAML and MFA/WebAuthn/device assurance validation.

  • testtests/enterprise-platform.test.js

    Automated federation certification, MFA, metadata and provider-policy evidence.

  • testtests/federated-access-runtime.test.js

    JWKS signature, claim, nonce, hardware/device and SAML validation-attestation evidence.

  • codepackages/core/src/identity/identity-integration-conformance.js

  • testtests/identity-integration-conformance.test.js

  • codepackages/core/src/identity/federated-revocation-verification.js

  • testtests/federated-revocation-verification.test.js

  • docdocs/architecture/tenant-role-staffing-and-feature-gating.md

SEC-003Partial

Scoped SCIM protocol provisioning/deprovisioning, group mapping, explicit all-session/canonical suspension, directory reconciliation and governed role requests

Core · Security & IAM · Owner: Information Security

Acceptance boundary

Certified SCIM events are idempotent; deactivation removes interactive and canonical authority immediately, while group additions only request roles through LoanOS maker-checker.

Current maturity and gap

The scoped protocol, explicit persisted-session revocation and provider-snapshot reconciliation exist. Commercial provider registration, provider-native token revocation conformance and measured vendor leaver SLA remain.

SEC-005Partial

Fine-grained scoped RBAC/ABAC, separation of duty, per-feature minimum staffing, deny-by-default mutation classification and isolated control-policy enforcement

Core · Security & IAM · Owner: Information Security

Acceptance boundary

Current scoped authority, hard SoD, distinct verified-human staffing and isolated control decisions gate every protected feature; access loss pauses unsafe work without delaying containment.

Current maturity and gap

The kernel, persistent APIs, universal mutation gate, IAM operations UI and hardened control-fleet contract exist. Tenant shadow/cutover evidence and a separately deployed control fleet remain.
